Counsel for Opposite Party :- Aditya Gupta,G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Chandra Sharma,J.
Heard learned counsel for both the parties.

This transfer application on the part of the husband against the opposite party no.2 the wife with prayer to transfer the Complaint Case No.951/2021 (Smt. Priya Singh vs. Gaurav Singh and others)
from the court of learned Judicial Magistrate (Special Fast Track Court), District Mau u/s 20 of Domestic Violence Act, either at Jaunpur or at Varanasi.

sentences.text: It is submitted by learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant is lviing at Jaunpur and was married to opposite party no.2.

Later on, due to matrimonial dispute a case u/s 498A, 323, 504 Gaurav Singh @ Vikas vs State Of U.P. And Another on 15 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/180277901/
1 I.P.C. & 3/4 D.P. Act was got registered at Varanasi on 21.07.2021 by the opposite party no.2.

entities.text: Gaurav Singh @ Vikas vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: She was working in Orthopaedic Department, B.H.U. at that time and still today she is working at Varanasi not at Mau.

She lodged the subsequent F.I.R. against the applicant and other members of his family on 11.01.2024 u/s 504, 506, 509 I.P.C. in which she has again mentioned her address as Krishna Nagar Colony, Pokhra Pahadiya, Sarnath District Varanasi which shows that even today she is living at Varanasi not at Mau.
It is further submitted that even today she is working as Assistant Sales Manager at Varanasi and does not live at Mau.

It is also submitted that counter affidavit filed on behalf of the opposite party also shows that at present she is resident of Daulatnagar Colony Pandey Pokhra Pahadiya, District Varansi which has been filed on 18.11.2023.

Both the aforesaid cases are going on at Varansi and this case under Domestic Violence Act is pending before the learned court of Judicial Magistrate, Mau therefore, requested to transfer the case from Mau to Varanasi in view of the convenience to both the parties.
Learned counsel for the opposite party contends that the permanent residence of the opposite party is at Mau and she is living with her parents.
The contention that she was working in Orthopedic Department, B.H.U. is correct but at present she is not working there.
She was working prior to the marriage with the applicant.

When there was maltreatment by the applicant she lodged an F.I.R. at Varanasi and then went to Mau to live with her parents that was the reason present application u/s 20 Domestic Violence Act was filed before the learned court at Mau.
The second F.I.R. was lodged by her at Varanasi showing the address of her sister's house on the basis of threat given by the applicant.
In view of the convenience of opposite party no.2 the wife, the case cannot be transferred to the jurisdiction of learned court at Varanasi only on the basis of mention of address of Varanasi.

He relies on the law as laid down in Neelam Kanwar vs. Devinder Singh Kanwar 2000 (8) Supreme 184 in which the case was got transferred to the place where lady was residing in view of the convenience and also relies the order dated 16.03.2011 passed by co-ordinate Bench of this Court in Transfer Application No.119 of 2011.
Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, submission made by learned counsel for the parties and the fact that the applicant is resident of Jaunpur and was married to opposite party no.2 in the year 2021 when she was working in Orthopaedic Department, B.H.U. as is evident from the contents of the F.I.R. lodged by her at Varanasi on 21.07.2021.

entities.text: Neelam Kanwar vs. Devinder Singh Kanwar 2000 (8) Supreme 184
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Again she lodged an F.I.R. as Crime No.11 of 2024 showing her address at Krishna Nagar Colony, Pahadiya, Sarnath, Varanasi whereas in counter affidavit filed by opposite party no.2 her address has been shown as Daulat Nagar Colony,
Pandey Pokhra, Pahadiya and also the fact that she is working as Assistant Sales Manager,
Headquarter Varanasi, it also shows that she is living at Varanasi not at Mau and the proceedings in other two cases are going on before the learned court at Varanasi, therefore, it will be convenient to both the parties to get the case u/s 20 Domestic Violence Act transferred from the learned court at Mau to learned court at Varanasi having equivalent jurisdiction.
Accordingly, this transfer application is, hereby, allowed.
